authority: R-IV.1309(b), design board 13 ("Agora additions", states A/B/C). MOCK-FIRST: every value in the three states below is FAKE and exists so Nick can approve the layout before the live path renders it. The live card reads /api/stable/regime-strategy and never this file.
why_a_fixture: The three states cannot all occur on one day. A is today's; B needs a session where no rule matched; C needs the bar series to stop. Waiting for the tape to produce B and C is waiting for two faults, so the fixture forces each one and the live renderer is the SAME code path reading the SAME field names.
field_contract: Each state is a partial /api/stable/regime-strategy payload. The keys here are the keys the live payload uses -- regime_label, regime_key, held_no_match, data_freshness, blocked, costs, ma200_row -- so a renderer that works on the fixture works on the live read. backend/services/regime_card_v21.py lints that, and the suite runs the lint.
